question: How much do initialization and collocation-sampling seeds vary the fixed-budget outcomes, and do the spatial-density/time-node contrasts persist across paired seeds?

training.ansatz: u=u0(x)+t*MLP(sin(x),cos(x),t/end)[:3]; p=MLP[...,3]. Exact initial velocity and periodic inputs. No exact transient velocity labels.
training.loss: Mean squared continuity plus sum of three mean squared momentum residuals, equally weighted, no adaptive weighting.

new_runs.run_order: seed-major, then cases in listed order

analysis_plan.primary_metric: endpoint velocity relative L2 on the same 64^3 evaluation grid
secondary_metrics: sampled autograd gradient peak relative error
sampled autograd vorticity peak relative error
analysis_plan.summary: Report every seed-case result, then per-case mean, median, sample standard deviation, minimum and maximum. Also show paired within-seed contrasts between n=16/32/64 at five time nodes and between 5/9/17 time nodes at n=64.
analysis_plan.acceptance_thresholds: None. Descriptive seed-robustness study only; do not retrofit the OpenFOAM 5% threshold or label a PINN accuracy pass.
analysis_plan.limits: All seeds share the same fixed held-out validation points and time nodes. Five seeds do not establish asymptotic convergence, optimizer convergence, a population-wide guarantee, or continuous-domain extrema.
